ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Better Work Tab v1.1 overhauls RimWorld's Work tab with drag-and-drop ordering, skill overlays, automation rules, extended priorities up to 99, workloads, dividers, and visual customization.
Features are toggleable in settings.
Compatibility: - Compatible with most work-type mods - [FSF] Complex Jobs column ordering is supported - Vanilla Skills Expanded passion types are supported in rule conditions when the mod is active - Do Once - Noncommittal Work is compatible; BWT suppresses its duplicate borrowed menu patches and uses BWT's sub-work-aware version - Useful Marks markers appear on pawn icons when available - Grouped Pawns List is overridden inside this Work tab - CompactWorkTab overlaps this UI and should not be used together - Fluffy WorkTab and forks are hard conflicts
Version support: - 0.17 -> v1.1 - Multiplayer does not work
Support: Discord: https://discord.gg/QYBBaRkKWs
